g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-412 Bench spindle capper (built in house) · rev B
SS 304 (ASTM A240 plate / A554 tube / A276 bar)
No product contact (caps on): #4 brushed or bead blast; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5
W3 SEAT BAR STITCH BOTH SIDES
12 x M3 x 8 DEEP AT 40 PITCH ON CL,

svg.text: seat face A flat over 500 after welding
A parallel to column side C
BASE PLATE HOLES (from the spindle axis)
304 sq tube 2 x 2 in x 11 ga
1. Weld sequence: W2 column to base (tack 4 corners, check square to the base 0.5 / 600 both ways), W1 gussets, W4 cap, W5 clevis, W3 seat bar stitches alternating sides.
2. After welding: mill seat face A flat 0.05 over 500 and parallel to the column side 0.1; ream the clevis Ø10.2 square to the column side; drill/tap M3 x 12 on CL using the rail.
3. Tap base holes after welding (B M8, C M6, D M16 x 1.5); check the stop-rod hole D square to the base.
4. Column left face (-x): 2 x M4 stainless rivnut for the limit switch P1-452, set at assembly against the carriage plate top (carriage up), see P1-412-003.
5. Break all edges 0.5; #4 brush; passivate. Column top cap weld ground smooth (lever swings over it).
